[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: B6_LIQUIDATION_TOO_CLOSE
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: After the fill, the liquidation price of the position lies too close beyond the stop, or is unknown (B6_LIQUIDATION_TOO_CLOSE).
Position: A position is open with a confirmed stop, but it may be liquidated before the stop is reached.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert. An open stop is kept until the position is flat; the stop is never cancelled here.
You must: Check the exchange position, its liquidation price and the journal before any manual action. If the position is still open, close it or reduce the risk yourself.
